whyThisMatters: A tree surgeon, a homeowner, or a conveyancer needs to know if a tree is protected before someone cuts it. TPO Checker is a UK postcode lookup for tree preservation orders, plus paid property reports and branded reports for a business. Founded in July 2026. Owen Dawson. Stripe-verified means the listing is connected to Stripe. I do not log in and re-check the number. The 16 November 2026 sync shows 813 dollars in the last 30 days, and 2,308 dollars all-time. No subscription shows up, because each payment is for a report. The public council data is the raw material. The paid report is the product. Councils publish the orders. The product turns a postcode into a yes or no before someone cuts the tree. Owen Dawson, founded July 2026, and the business tier is for the trade.
